title: Year 12 Biology Module 8 – Non-infectious Disease and Disorders
description: A fast-recall review of NSW Year 12 Biology Module 8, organised by its five Inquiry Questions. Questions use short answers and avoid multi-step calculations or extended writing.
author: Generated with Classroom Jeopardy Quiz Maker

categories.name: How is the internal environment maintained?

questions.prompt: What process maintains internal conditions within tolerable limits?
What type of feedback reverses a change away from a set point?
What part of a feedback system detects a change or stimulus?
What part of a feedback system carries out the corrective response?
What hormone lowers blood glucose concentration?

categories.name: Do non-infectious diseases cause more deaths?

questions.prompt: Can a non-infectious disease normally be transmitted from person to person?
What type of non-infectious disease results from inherited or acquired changes in DNA?
What disease category can result from long-term exposure to substances such as asbestos?
questions.answer: Disease caused by environmental exposure. Accept: environmental disease.

questions.prompt: What type of disease can result from a deficiency or excess of nutrients?
What disease involves uncontrolled cell division and tumour formation?
What field studies the distribution and patterns of disease in populations?
What term means the number of new cases of a disease in a population over a period?
What term means the total number or proportion of existing disease cases in a population?
What term describes the frequency of deaths in a population?
What factor associated with an increased chance of disease is identified in many epidemiological studies?

categories.name: How can non-infectious diseases be prevented?

questions.prompt: What public strategy uses information to encourage healthier behaviour?
questions.answer: An education campaign. Accept: health campaign.

questions.prompt: What process tests people without symptoms to detect disease or risk early?
What advice can help people understand inherited disease risks and reproductive options?
What broad prevention approach aims to reduce exposure to known disease risk factors?
What technology deliberately alters genetic material and may be used in prevention or treatment strategies?

categories.name: How can technology assist people with disorders?

questions.prompt: What device amplifies sound for many people with hearing loss?
What implanted device directly stimulates the auditory nerve for some types of hearing loss?
What simple optical technology corrects many refractive vision disorders?
What surgery reshapes the cornea to correct some refractive vision problems?
questions.answer: Laser eye surgery. Accept: laser surgery.

questions.prompt: What treatment filters wastes and excess water from the blood when kidneys fail?

finalRound.prompt: What type of feedback mechanism counteracts a change and returns an internal condition towards its normal range?
